* SaLerm Protein Shampoo Contains and Exclusive Salerm Keratin-Polyquaternium Complex Mild conditioner shampoo: for use on all kinds of hair and especially permanents, dyed or discolored hair. The active components a combination of keratin (natural protein) and repairers of the capilary structures make it ideal for use after the operations carried out in most hairdressing saloons: it gives the hair a soft, smooth feeling and, at the same time, it makes the hair more lustrous, increases its volume and helps to fix the dye-colors. Its combination of active substances helps strengthen the weaker and/or brittle hairs; it strengthens them, gives them vitality and, at the same time, keeps them from losing their natural properties. SaLerm Protein Balsam Conditioner Contains Selective Collagen SALERM Protein Balsam Conditioner has been specailly created to treat damaged hair (due to sun or sea exposure, permanent waves, tinting or lightening, etc.) and restore its natural balance, leaving it soft, shiny and easy to comb. The ACID pH of the formula makes it ideal for neutralising the alkaline effect of tinting, lightening and permanent treatments. DIRECTIONS : Apply after shampooing once hair has been slightly dried with a towel. Leave for 2 or 3 minutes. Rinse well. *Salerm21 is more than a conditioner or leave-on hydrating mask that instantly revives and treats damaged hair. Its special formula based on silk proteins gets right to the very core of the hair. Leaves hair lively and shiny and is perfect for protecting hair from the sun,heat,pool chlorine and salt water.

Neem is respected by Ayurveda practitioners for its ability to support healthy skin and scalps. Used for centuries, Neem protects, nourishes and moisturizes even the most sensitive skin. Use TheraNeem Gentle Therapy Shampoo to nourish the hair and scalp. The original TheraNeem Shampoo with organic Neem Oil & Neem Leaf Extract, Chamomile, Arnica, Pine, Basil and Cherry Bark, this formula will clean gently and penetrate the scalp without harsh chemicals or soaps. Set of 3.

GET SOFTER, SHINIER HAIR - Our vegan shampoo and conditioner wash away dirt and excess oil from your scalp and hair while nourishing them with amino acids and vitamins, which make your hair irresistibly softer and shinier.
PROMOTE HEALTHY HAIR GROWTH - Growing your hair faster is possible with the growth-boosting nutrients in our paraben free shampoo and conditioner. These hair care essentials are rich in Hydrolysed Whey Protein, Amino Acids, and Panthenol.
ACHIEVE STRONG, THICK HAIR - Feed your hair the nutrients it truly needs. Our paraben free shampoo and conditioner nourish from root to tips, hence promoting healthy hair growth after every wash. Less hair fall and breakage!
SUITABLE FOR ALL HAIR TYPES - Hairburst color safe shampoo and conditioner work well on any hair types. Normal, dry, thin, curly - you name it! Make our growth-enhancing, moisturizing shampoo and conditioner a staple in your daily hair care regimen.
SAFE FOR EVERYDAY USE - The cruelty free shampoo and conditioner are free of parabens and sodium lauryl sulfate, so you don’t have to worry about dryness or flaking. It has coconut and avocado that nourish while leaving your hair smelling awesome!

The combination of fresh and fruity notes, Dark Pomegranate & sandalwood make AXE Anarchy 3-in-1 Shampoo, Conditioner and Body Wash a luxurious addition to your daily shower routine. Let the lather wash and rejuvenate you, keeping you smelling clean all day. To protect against odors no matter what your day brings.

PLANT-BASED INGREDIENTS: Formulated with apple cider vinegar and botanical extracts the shampoo and conditioner deliver smooth hair and restore its natural shine.
UNSCENTED SHAMPOO AND CONDITIONER FORMULA: Perfectly unscented and designed for those who are sensitive to fragrance.
NO HARSH CHEMICALS: Both shampoo and conditioner are sls free, paraben free, phthalate free, biodegradable, cruelty free, vegan, gluten free and contain no dyes.
GENTLE AND EFFECTIVE: The shampoo and conditioner set delivers salon performance while infusing the hair with natural derived ingredients. It balances the pH of the hair and scalp, smooths cuticles and tames frizzies, leaving the hair moisturized, shiny and silky smooth. Lightweight and safe for all types of hair including color treated hair.
